bugs_found: compound_interest uses r/(n+1) instead of r/n, silently undercalculating interest
transfer is not atomic: debit occurs before credit, so a failure adding to destination can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, allowing type errors or non-Decimal inputs after partial checks
transfer only blocks same object, not same account id, allowing logical self-transfers via distinct Account instances
fx_convert does not validate rates are positive/nonzero, allowing negative or zero FX rates
integer casts silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year instead of rejecting non-integer inputs
